summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  ### What I found from auditing the code (read-only) I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`, plus the auth side (`db/auth.ts`, `modules/auth/handlers.ts`, `useAuth.tsx`).  Contrary to the ticket's hypothesis, **I did not find an obvious wiring bug**: - `watchlists` table has a `user_id` column; every handler (`GET /`, `GET /:id`, `POST /:id/items`, `DELETE /:id/items/:itemId`, etc.) filters strictly by `eq(watchlists.user_id
